title: Month 13
subtitle: The guide changes shape here. A month is a long time at this age, so the steps are fewer and they matter more.

baby.development: Your child is walking, or close to it, and can say a few words. They understand much more than they can say, and they are starting to test what happens when they do something you said not to.

you.body: If you are breastfeeding, you can keep going for as long as you both want. If you were formula feeding, the switch to whole milk happened last month.
you.mind: The first year is over and you did it. The second year is different: more opinion, more movement, and the same amount of love.

coreActions.title: Know that a tantrum is not defiance
coreActions.why: A one-year-old has big feelings and almost no words for them. The behaviour is the communication.
coreActions.detail: Name the feeling, stay nearby, and do not try to reason with a screaming child. It peaks between eighteen months and three years. Hitting and biting are common and are handled by a calm no and a redirect, not by punishment.

coreActions.title: Watch for the move to one nap
coreActions.why: Most children drop to one nap between twelve and eighteen months, and the sign is a second nap that pushes bedtime too late.
coreActions.detail: The usual pattern is a morning nap that gets shorter and a long afternoon nap. If the second nap is still happening at four in the afternoon and bedtime is a fight, drop it and move lunch earlier.

coreActions.title: Let them walk barefoot indoors
coreActions.why: Bare feet give better feedback than shoes, and the feedback is what builds balance.
coreActions.detail: Bare feet on a firm floor indoors. Shoes are for outside, and they should be flexible with a thin sole. A child who is not walking by eighteen months is worth mentioning at the visit.

alsoKnow.title: Whole milk until two
alsoKnow.body: Whole milk, two to three cups a day, until the second birthday. After two, the fat can come down to 2% if the child is eating well. Milk is a drink, not a meal replacement.

alsoKnow.title: A dental visit by the first birthday
alsoKnow.body: A check by the first tooth or the first birthday, whichever came first. It is short, it is mostly a look, and it sets up the habit.

redFlags.text: Choking — cannot breathe, cough, or make a sound
A fever over 100.4°F with unusual sleepiness or a rash
Feeling hopeless, or thoughts of harming yourself or the child
